$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/cinatra — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-07-03 re-pin (cinatra-ai/ci gate-caller realign to ci main @45826486a3965bc8ebd6203a26330ad0dc1ae511): all three ci gate callers (truthful-attribution, source-leak, skills-drift) advanced to the same-SHA double-pin uses:@45826486 + with.ref 45826486, rolling out the merged ci engine fixes (cinatra-ai/ci#56 skills-drift push-arm PR-body ack, cinatra-ai/ci#58 source-leak public-strict profile availability, cinatra-ai/ci#59 merge_group diff base — inert without a merge queue, cinatra-ai/ci#60 approval-staleness content/diff binding). requiredContexts[].pinned must equal the SHA referenced_workflows reports for each caller's uses:@ (the gate matches exactly, fail closed), so both entries move 83ca29ef->45826486 in this same commit (version 2026.06.5->2026.07.1). Audit basis: the reusable truthful-attribution-gate workflow YAML is byte-identical 83ca29ef..45826486; config/high-risk-defaults.json is unchanged 0de02f3..45826486 (the 2026.06.5 superset entries still satisfy the engine); the post-merge push arm was audited live on main (runs on every push, enforce mode fail-closed, genuine record violations red-flagged and corrected during 2026-07-02/03). 45826486 is a clean descendant of 83ca29ef on cinatra-ai/ci main; protected by the high-risk-path review on .github/workflows/** and **/gate-suite.json. version is bumped whenever the pinned content changes (suiteId@version must be immutable per content). Prior record (2026-06-28): callers realigned 7e6e94c9->83ca29ef via PR #637/#646 (source-leak, version 2026.06.2->2026.06.3) and PR #638 (truthful-attribution, version 2026.06.3->2026.06.4).
